title: MSFS Marketplace Update: 13 NEW add-ons, airline schedules & Norway Bush trip!
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of new content for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. If you're looking to bring maximum realism to your commercial airline operations and scenic tours, this week delivers 13 brand-new featured releases packed with classic 747 bundles, commemorative liveries, international airport schedules, and a massive guided tour across Norway. We divide the breakdown into four major categories:

✈️ Curated Bundles & Commemorative Airliner Packs: A deep dive into brand-new flight packages, liveries, and missions. We break down the Master Collection Vol. 5 bundle from Perfect Flight (featuring classic Boeing 747 missions for KLM, Iberia, and British Airways with charts and custom flight deck events) alongside the America 250 Southwest Airlines commemorative A320v2 package with 12 dedicated IFR missions.

📅 Global Airline Fleet Schedules (Summer Overhaul): A complete summary of the massive real-world summer schedules from VA Systems. We cover new summer route rotations and liveries for Cathay Pacific (CPA), flydubai (FDB), Frontier Airlines (FFT), TUI Airways (TOM), and Alliance Airlines (UTY) to fill your virtual flight log.

🌍 International Hub Traffic Overhauls: A look at the new multi-airline airport traffic and real-world summer schedule injections across major global gateways. We highlight comprehensive schedule coverage for Toronto Pearson (CYYZ), Rome Fiumicino (LIRF), Riyadh King Khalid (OERK), Singapore Changi (WSSS), and Adelaide (YPAD).

🏔️ Scenic General Aviation Excursions: Throttle back and explore the Arctic to the fjords in the new Norway VFR Guided Bush Trip by Perfect Flight. Spanning 12 detailed VFR missions from the Barents Sea down to the Oslofjord in the Beechcraft Bonanza G36, complete with 220 custom narrated audio recordings.

Whether you want to command long-haul heavy routes with Cathay Pacific, populate busy mega hubs like Singapore Changi and Toronto Pearson with real-world traffic, or explore Scandinavia in the Bonanza G36, this marketplace drop brings immense operational variety to your hangar.

Drop a comment below and let me know: Are you team airline operations or team scenic bush trip this week? Make sure to smash the like button, subscribe to High in the Flightsim Sky for weekly flight simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
